cases.question: What is COMP 4537 Internet Software Architecture about?
cases.standalone_question: What is the course content and description for COMP 4537 Internet Software Architecture?
cases.answer_excerpt:
COMP 4537 Internet Software Architecture focuses on the design, development, and management of web APIs.

The course covers the following key areas:
*   **RESTful APIs:** Understanding what they are, why they are important, and how they relate to HTTP.
*   **Core Concepts:** Exploring REST constraints, CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations, and the use of HTTP status codes.
*   **Practical Skills:** Designing and developing web services, documenting specifications, implementing error handling, and securing backend API servers.
*   **Management:** Applying versioning and change management to API designs.

This is a 3.0-credit course offered within the Computer Systems Technology (CST) Diploma program. It requires the completion of COMP 1537 and COMP 3522 as prerequisites.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/courses/internet-software-architecture-comp-4537/
- https://www.bcit.ca/programs/computer-systems-technology-diploma-full-time-5500dipma/

cases.question: What are the three main topic areas covered in COMP 1113 Applied Mathematics?
cases.standalone_question: What are the three main topic areas covered in COMP 1113 Applied Mathematics?
cases.answer_excerpt:
The course COMP 1113, Applied Mathematics, is divided into the following three main topic areas:

*   **Boolean algebra and the design of logic circuits:** This includes concepts such as truth tables, canonical forms, and the simplification of Boolean expressions.
*   **Number systems and data representation:** This covers positional number systems and how various data types (numbers, text, and graphics) are represented within a computer, including arithmetic operations in different bases.
*   **Functions, linear equations, vectors, and matrices:** This involves solving systems of linear equations, performing matrix operations, and using algebraic methods or determinants.

Sources:

cases.question: Am I automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan, and can I opt out?
cases.standalone_question: Am I automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan, and can I opt out?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Yes, you are automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan if you meet specific eligibility criteria, and there is a process available to opt out if you already have comparable coverage.

### Automatic Enrollment
You are automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan if you meet the following requirements:
*   You are a student in a program designated as full-time by BCIT.
*   Your program is at least 16 weeks in length.

If you meet these criteria, the health fee is automatically included in your tuition upon registration. Students in part-time programs or ISEP are not eligible for this plan.

### Opting Out
If you already have comparable extended health and dental benefits, you have the option to opt out of the BCITSA plan. Please note the following:
*   **Deadline:** You must submit your opt-out request within 30 days from the start of your program.
*   **Frequency:** Opt-outs can be processed once per 12-month period.
*   **Restriction:** After the 30-day deadline has passed, opt-outs cannot be processed.

For further assistance or to confirm your eligibility, you can visit or contact the BCITSA Health & Dental Plan Office located in building SE2 on the Burnaby campus.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/full-time-studies/
- https://www.bcitsa.ca/student-services/health-dental/
- https://www.bcit.ca/international-students/medical-insurance/types-of-insurance/
- https://www.bcitsa.ca/about-us/student-fees/

cases.question: Three quick questions: is peer tutoring free, can I opt out of the BCITSA health and dental plan, and what student residences are on the Burnaby campus?
cases.standalone_question: Is peer tutoring free at BCIT, can I opt out of the BCITSA health and dental plan, and what student residences are on the Burnaby campus?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Here are the answers to your questions:

1. **Is peer tutoring free?**
Yes, peer tutoring is free and available to all BCIT students. It is offered on a drop-in basis, so no advance registration is required.

2. **How to opt out of the BCITSA health and dental plan?**
If you are a full-time student already covered by comparable extended health and dental benefits, you have the option to opt out of the BCITSA plan. You must process your opt-out within 30 days from the start of your program. You can find more information and initiate the process by visiting the BCITSA Student Plan website or the BCITSA Health & Dental Plan office located in building SE2 on the Burnaby campus.

3. **What student residences are on the BCIT Burnaby campus?**
This specific information is not in the available documents. You may wish to check the official BCIT website for information regarding campus housing and student residences.

cases.answer_excerpt:
The entrance requirements for the full-time Computer Systems Technology (CST) Diploma are as follows:

*   **English Language Proficiency:** Category 2 – English Studies 12 (67%) or equivalent.

cases.question: Which English proficiency categories does BCIT use for admissions?
cases.follow_up: What TOEFL iBT score does Category 2 require?
cases.standalone_question: What TOEFL iBT score does BCIT English proficiency Category 2 require?

prior_turns.question: Which English proficiency categories does BCIT use for admissions?

cases.answer_excerpt:
For Category 2, the required TOEFL iBT score depends on the date of your program start:

*   **Prior to January 21, 2026:** An overall score of 86 is required, with no section score less than 20.
*   **As of January 21, 2026:** An overall score of 4.5 is required, with a minimum score of 3.5 in each of the Speaking, Writing, Reading, and Listening sections.

Please note that for assessment tests, your results must be dated no more than two years before your program start date.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/entrance-requirements/english-language-proficiency/
